The broad clearly muscular shoulders, torso, upper arms, forearms, sturdy legs, and leading-shoulder posture remain recognizably derived from the source without body-fat inflation.
The forearms remain muscular, but both clenched hands—especially the forward right fist—are generically enlarged beyond the source hand-to-wrist proportions.
The dense violet-plum-pink curls-and-coils halo, side-swept gathered mass, parting, and one shaved side preserve the source hair silhouette and color.

The ochre-cream shaped short jacket, broad folded collar, practical closures, divided hem, generous trousers, and low boots remain legible, but a new earlobe stud violates the exact no-accessory and no-tattoo source manifest.
Original-resolution inspection places the complete head-and-hair unit at approximately 39–40% of standing height, clearly above the frozen 32–36% range and into baby-proportion territory.
Exactly one subject is shown with the entire hair and head, both empty hands, both low boots, and grounding shadow fully contained inside generous parchment margins.
The planted offset stance, compact silhouette, squared shoulders, and ready empty fists read clearly as a weaponless combat ready-idle at icon scale.
The practical cloth layers and boots remain grounded mortal design with no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
